exercises.q: What does под- add in подойти́?
options: describing an action of copying or following someone's action
describing a meaning that shows a finished action or an obtainment of a result
alternative form of под- (used before certain consonant clusters)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists подойти́ under this meaning of под-. Source: Wiktionary, «под-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/под-#Russian).
**подошло** — подойти́ (perfective): to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near; to fit, to suit, to match, to be right. Wiktionary: подо- + -йти.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **подошло** — подойти́ (perfective): to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near; to fit, to suit, to match, to be right. Wiktionary: подо- + -йти.

exercises.why: **отходи** — отходи́ть (imperfective): to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside; (military) to withdraw, to fall back; (colloquial) to go away temporarily (with the intention to come back soon); (colloquial) to come around, to come back to normal (e.g. after a shock or disease). Wiktionary: от- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does от- add in отбежа́ть?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists отбежа́ть under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: What does из- add in изгоня́ть?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists изгоня́ть under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).

exercises.q: Anglicisms must be banned from your vocabulary.
exercises.why: **изгонять** — изгоня́ть (imperfective): to exile, to banish; (religion) to exorcise. Wiktionary: из- + гоня́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does до- add in дойти́?
options: adding to what there was before
fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
completing an action, reaching a goal
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists дойти́ under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).
**дошло** — дойти́ (perfective): to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach; to come down to; (prices) to rise, to run up to, to amount to; (vulgar) to ejaculate, to cum. Wiktionary: до- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I'm at the end of my rope.
exercises.why: **дошёл** — дойти́ (perfective): to go to, to come to, to arrive at, to reach; to come down to; (prices) to rise, to run up to, to amount to; (vulgar) to ejaculate, to cum. Wiktionary: до- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near
to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: подойти́ — to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near; отходи́ть — to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside; отбежа́ть — to run back; изгоня́ть — to exile, to banish.
